label: Посмотреть
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for посмотреть (to look, watch).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person singular. 'Посмотрю' is the simple future of perfective посмотреть and needs no auxiliary. It marks one finished act of watching.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second-person singular. 'Посмотришь' shows the -ишь ending of посмотреть. 'На эту картину' uses на with the accusative for the direction of a single glance.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person singular. 'Посмотрит' is the simple future pointing to one completed viewing. Its imperfective partner смотреть would describe regular or ongoing watching instead.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Посмотрим' carries the -им ending and promises a single shared event. 'Вместе' adds a natural social setting.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, polite or plural. 'Посмотрите' is the respectful -ите future, here a near-instruction to check the schedule. 'Заранее' stresses the completed, advance action.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, masculine. 'Посмотрел' is the masculine -л past, marking a finished viewing. 'Интересный спектакль' is the accusative object of the one-time act.

missions.phrase: Она посмотрела на часы и ушла.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective past, feminine. 'Посмотрела' adds the feminine -ла ending. The pair of perfectives shows a brisk sequence of completed actions.
Strategic focus: Perfective past, plural. 'Посмотрели' is the plural -ли past for all genders. 'Старые фотографии' is the accusative object of a finished, shared activity.
Strategic focus: Perfective infinitive. 'Посмотреть' stays infinitive after the modal 'хочу'. The perfective points to one deliberate look; imperfective смотреть would mark ongoing gazing.
Strategic focus: Perfective imperative, singular. 'Посмотри' is the informal command of посмотреть, urging one quick look. It contrasts with imperfective смотри, which invites continued watching.
